metadata.title: Golden Hour Portrait with Retro Flourishes

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, warm-toned close-up portrait of a woman's face, partially obscured by shadow on one side, framed by golden-yellow organic swirls and stylized geometric typography in the lower right quadrant.
coreVisualRelationships: High-contrast chiaroscuro lighting on the face creating depth and mood.
Monochromatic golden-yellow color palette unifying the photography and graphic elements.
Organic, flowing vector swirls contrasting with the rigid geometric structure of the display type.
Tight cropping that emphasizes the eyes and facial features as the primary focal point.
coreInvariants: Golden-yellow monochromatic wash over the entire composition.
Heavy shadow on the left side of the subject's face.
Filigree-style vector ornaments in the corners.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Extreme close-up portrait centered horizontally, filling the majority of the frame vertically.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes, particularly the one in the light, serve as the primary anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the eyes, moves down the bridge of the nose to the lips, then follows the curve of the shoulder to the text block in the lower right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is densely packed with facial features and decorative elements.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Golden yellow (#FFD700) provides the base for highlights and graphic elements.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep umber and black provide the shadows and define the facial structure.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright white-yellow for the hottest highlights on the skin and hair.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the yellows with a wide value range from deep blacks to bright highlights.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid cool tones like blue or green

letterConstructionRules: Tight letter spacing with some ligatures or overlaps
Lowercase 'a' with a circular bowl and no spur
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'g' features a simplified circular loop

composition.relationshipToImage: Overlaid on dark shoulder area for contrast

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A heavy, rounded geometric display font paired with a light, tracked-out secondary sans-serif.

preserve: Circular geometry of the main text

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the rounded, geometric, and circular counter style.
Provides the geometric foundation for the display text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a close-up portrait of a woman with blonde hair, lit with strong golden-yellow light from the right side, leaving the left side in deep shadow. Apply a warm, monochromatic yellow-orange filter and a subtle film grain. Add golden vector swirls and filigree patterns in the corners, particularly the bottom left and bottom right.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the display text in the lower right quadrant using a bold, rounded geometric sans-serif font in golden yellow. Stack the primary name and place a secondary line of text in all-caps, widely tracked, directly underneath.

verificationChecks: Is the lighting high-contrast and monochromatic yellow?
Are the vector swirls present in the corners?
Is the typography geometric and stacked in the lower right?
Is the subject's face the primary focus?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the yellow color wash
mustRedesign: Specific facial identity of the artist
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text is legible against the background.
Verify the golden color is vibrant and not dull brown.
Check that the vector swirls do not obscure the eyes.
Confirm the composition feels balanced despite the asymmetrical text.
recipe.reuseFormula: Close-up portrait + monochromatic warm wash + geometric display type + corner filigree = 2000s Pop Aesthetic.
